creative.name: Same board. Different moves.
creative.headline:
SAME BOARD.
NEW OPTIONS.
creative.body: The pieces are visible. The context may be missing.
creative.note: Check the turn, castling rights and last pawn move.
creative.alternate:
CHECK THE BOARD.
CHECK THE CONTEXT.
creative.caption: A chess screenshot can omit information that changes the legal moves. Check the turn, castling rights and last pawn move before analysing the position. Read the lesson and explore the Academy.
creative.measure: Saves per reach; qualified lesson and Academy visits
sequence: Ask what the board can hide.
Explain the difference and invite practice.
